title: AI Price Index index.json (published artifact)
description: The thin, mutable pointer at the root of the published dataset. Lists every model and the content-hashed file that holds its series. The only file with a short cache TTL; the per-model files are immutable (their filename hash changes on every edit).

license.description: SPDX id of the data license, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the content-hashed series file.

latestRev.description: Content hash of the current series file.

aliases.description: Optional alternate model ids that resolve to this canonical model (sorted, deduped).
